notes.notes: [h1]Happy 2nd Anniversary![/h1][p][/p][p]Time really flies — [b]Party Animals[/b] is officially turning [b]TWO[/b]![/p][p]Huge thanks to all the players for your support, enthusiasm, and honest feedback. It’s your passion that keeps the world of [b]Party Animals[/b] growing, evolving, and getting even more chaotic (in a good way)![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/8355a833aaf568729d0aa99859aa3d3aa785b477.png"][/img][/p][p]In the year to come, we'll keep working hard to bring you even more creative maps, wild mechanics, and fresh chaos. [/p][list][*][p]From [b]Sept 19, 9:00 PM (PT)[/b] to [b]Sept 26, 9:00 PM (PT)[/b], log in daily for 7 days to receive [b]50 Treats [/b]per day![/p][/*][*][p]The [b]2nd Anniversary Outfits [/b]will be available in the [b]Autumn Cabin vending machine[/b] from [b]Sept 19, 9:00 PM (PT)[/b] to [b]Oct 3, 9:00 PM (PT)[/b] for a limited time![/p][/*][*][p][b]1st Anniversary Skins[/b] will also return during the same period — don't miss them this time![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Autumn Cabin – Let[/b]'[b]s Go Fishing[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]After two years of snow, the Winter Cabin has finally thawed. Underneath the snow, [b]a crystal-clear river[/b] was quietly waiting to be discovered![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/87edd15c80b75b16c9485d9427042ee42b81fb96.png"][/img][/p][p]During the day, the sun is warm and cozy. At night, the lights come on and the riverbank falls into a quiet calm.[/p][p][/p][p]You'll find cats fishing by the river, dogs chatting, and the occasional sound of card games (and explosions) coming from inside the cabin.[/p][p][/p][p]Come fish in the Autumn Cabin! [b]Party Animals never blank on a catch![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Global Event: Fishing Marathon[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/636b5c0fdef98dab9fb0e15085b45dfe5b65e2d0.png"][/img][/p][p]Come fish with us in the Autumn Cabin![/p][p]From [b]Sept 19, 9:00 PM (PT)[/b] to [b]Nov 14, 9:00 PM (PT)[/b], sell fish to earn event points, which contribute to both "My Progress" and "Community Progress." When both progress bars hit the same milestone, you'll unlock the reward. Fishing-themed outfits and plenty of other prizes are waiting for you![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Limited-Time Mode – What If?[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]During his journey across the Party Animals world, explorer Nemo accidentally discovered a rift to a parallel universe — these worlds feel familiar, but everything's just a little… off.[/p][p][/p][p]Gravity-defying Ichiban, Typoon full of bombs, cats with giant heads, and dogs running around with balloons…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/f4d250533c43733109fef735f73b6502ecb3a2b0.png"][/img][/p][p]What would happen if the rules suddenly changed?[/p][p][/p][p]From [b]Sept 19, 9:00 PM (PT)[/b] to [b]Oct 20, 8:59 AM (PT)[/b], the limited-time event mode [b]What If?[/b] is now open![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Party Animals Gallery – [/b]Season 3[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/558a2765fd2ab273b215823459bd7f2a481b6d78.png"][/img][/p][p]The winning entries of the [b]3rd Party Animals Photo Contest[/b] are now on display in the gallery —[/p][p]go check if your photo made it onto the wall![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Return of the Gods[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/f3a072dfb72075e2667f8808fdbe6c9344efbd10.png"][/img][/p][p]Mount Olympus is calling! New outfits [b]“Artemis Yurusa”[/b] and [b]“Hermes Fluffy”[/b] will be available in the Item Shop from [b]Sept 20, 9:00 PM (PT)[/b] to [b]Oct 11, 9:00 PM (PT)[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]The previously released [b]Greek Gods[/b] outfits will also return during this time.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Human Fall Flat[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/696ae3974c7476f67d4d2a11a295438ae6dbb45f.png"][/img][/p][p]Let's welcome [b]Buddy[/b] from "Human Fall Flat" to Party Animals! From [b]Sept 19, 9:00 PM (PT)[/b] to [b]Dec 19, 9:00 PM (PT)[/b], log in to Party Animals to claim the collab outfit for free. Set your alarm, and make sure to update your game then![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Vicksy Collab 2.0[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/ffe1cbc7efdecb306834e78f097d01b47a7ff83f.png"][/img][/p][p]The collab chatbot outfit [b]Gekkerbot[/b], made in partnership with content creator [b]Vicksy[/b], will be available in the Item Shop starting [b]Sept 19, 9:00 PM (PT)[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Limited-Time Outfits Return[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]By popular demand, some [b]previously retired skins[/b], as well as [b]base characters[/b] from past Battle Passes, will return to the Item Shop from [b]Sept 18, 9:00 PM (PT)[/b] to [b]Nov 13, 8:00 PM (PT)[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/de6e7d85d9fa97edd21c5d68e9358c0ba754cd63.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/908b3cb307df6bc9cf3c1b2cd2a194fd0330f932.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/441b10cec274f2aed0cbdf5d1c72a74c516e2f0c.png"][/img]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/a8f332213e9402ff1059749ad9356bbca91a9c5b.png"][/img]   [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][olist][*][p]Fixed frame drops in Blackhole Lab when players with the "Milky Way Carrot" outfit got eliminated[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed AI failing to jump onto the opposite train in Fluffy Redemption[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemies sometimes failing to jump onboard the ship in Black Sails custom mode (beast difficulty)[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Optimizations[/h1][olist][*][p]Improved handling of key conflicts in game settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized update file size (effective starting from version 1.13.1)[/p][/*][*][p]Added rule descriptions to the pre-game lobby panel for[b] Crisis[/b] mode[/p][/*][*][p]Extended max duration of Autumn Cabin to 6 hours[/p][/*][*][p]Added 1 new main screen BGM and 1 new Autumn Cabin jukebox track.[/p][/*][/olist]

[h1]New Mode – Infection[/h1][p][/p][p]The little animals have stumbled upon an abandoned cannery. And what was really being produced here? notes.title: Patch Notes 1.11.0.0
notes.notes:
[h1]New Board Game – Bluffalo Club[/h1]

You know what the most brilliant trick is? Telling the truth—so convincingly that everyone thinks you're lying. And when the truth comes out, people are left in awe, not realizing you were just being flawlessly honest all along.

So, six hours after the announcement, The Bluff Club has arrived.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/31273e48d4be848db3ae9da31d289ec841402223.png[/img]
Say the most ridiculous things with the straightest face. If your friends don’t fall for it—keep going.

Join The Bluffalo Club and face off with your friends in a game full of half-truths and bold lies. This is how April Fools’ was meant to be played!

[h1]Feature Updates[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Added local split-screen support for two players in Nemo Kart mode (not supported on Xbox One yet).
[*] Added local split-screen support for two players in Smash mode.
[*] Added the ability to search for all modes or maps in Custom Game - Find Lobby.
[*] Added a Random Outfit option in the outfit selection screen.
[*] Crisis Mode now supports reconnection after disconnection
[/olist]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue in Winter Cabin - PAWS where characters might stay in abnormal animations if a player left the table while being electrocuted.
[*] Fixed an issue in Winter Cabin - PAWS where players indirectly electrocuted would be stunned and unable to recover.
[*] Fixed an issue in Crisis Mode where a player inside a vent during a meeting might not be able to exit the vent after the meeting ends.
[*] Fixed an issue in Crisis Mode where if a player whose appearance was copied by the Face/Off Killer left the match, the Face/Off Killer could no longer transform into that player.
[*] Fixed an issue in Crisis Mode where the chat box and private message window could appear at the same time on the results screen, but neither could be selected, preventing message sending.
[*] Fixed an issue in Buzz Ball where the buzz ball could fly out of the map under certain conditions, preventing the round from ending properly.
[/olist]
[h1]Optimizations[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Improved the wording of game status in the friend list to show what the player is currently doing and how long the session has been running.
[*] In the “Add New” tab of the friends list, increased the limit of the “Played Together” list to 100 players. The list will be saved after exitting the game.
[/olist]

[h2]Version 1.10.9.0 (2025.3.20)

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]  
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue in Crisis Mode where the "ready" icon could cover player emotes.

[*] Added a countdown timer display after the "Engineer" uses their ability in Crisis Mode.
[*] Expanded the selection of quick chat phrases in Crisis Mode and improved their layout.
[*] Optimized role distribution in Crisis Mode:
[olist]
[*] 12-player match: At least one goodie with a killing ability, and only one "Average Goodie" in each game.
[*] 8-player match: Neutral roles with only be those without a killing ability.
[/olist][/olist]

notes.title: Cats VS Dogs Rules Update
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

In the recent[b] Cats vs. Dogs event[/b], we heard a lot of frustration from players regarding the fact that [b]the losing faction could not obtain the final outfit of the opposing faction[/b]. We fully understand this disappointment. As a result, we’ve made the following improvements to the final reward rules:

[b]Original Rules:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Players in the [b]winning faction[/b] could [b]obtain their own faction’s final outfit for free[/b] after reaching tier 30 in their faction (with a gradual discount from tiers 1-30).
[*] Players in the [b]winning faction[/b] could [b]purchase the opposing faction’s final outfit at a 60% discount[/b] after reaching tier 30 spying in the opposing faction (with a gradual discount from tiers 1-30).
[*] Players in the [b]losing faction[/b] could [b]purchase their own faction’s final outfit at a 60% discount[/b] after reaching tier 30 (with a gradual discount from tiers 1-30).
[*] Players in the [b]losing faction[/b] could [b]not obtain the opposing faction’s final outfit [/b].
[/olist]

[b]New Rules:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/59d2816bb0b4c5d11b33e0272c6c8e88207c2ca2.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] Players in both the [b]winning[/b] and [b]losing factions[/b] can [b]obtain their own faction’s final outfit for free[/b] after reaching tier 30 in their faction (with a gradual discount from tiers 1-30).
[*] Players in the [b]winning faction[/b] can [b]obtain the opposing faction’s final outfit for free[/b] after reaching tier 30 spying in the opposing faction (with a gradual discount from tiers 1-30).
[*] Players in the [b]losing faction[/b] can [b]purchase the opposing faction’s final outfit [/b] at a 60% discount after reaching tier 30 spying in the opposing faction (with a gradual discount from tiers 1-30).
[*] Players in the [b]winning faction[/b] will [b]unconditionally receive a special namecard[/b] that represents victory in the event.
[*] Players in the [b]winning faction[/b] can also [b]obtain an upgraded version of their faction’s final outfit [/b] for free after reaching tier 30 (available only at tier 30 and above).
[/olist]

With these adjustments, we aim to give players from [b]both factions[/b] the opportunity to [b]obtain both factions' final outfits[/b], while also providing additional rewards for the [b]winning faction[/b], such as the [b]upgraded final outfit and the special victory namecard[/b]. We hope these changes will help bridge the reward gap between the two factions while ensuring that the winning side receives exclusive benefits.

We understand that the new rules may not address every concern, but we hope that this update will ease some of the frustration.

Thank you all for participating in this event!
And thank you for playing Party Animals!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.8.0.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/85ac4ad2a595588773d045a9ee7d1f7f99341e24.png[/img]
It's been one year since the launch of Party Animals! Over the past year, we've been incredibly grateful for all the love and support you've shown us. To celebrate this special occasion, we've introduced some exciting gameplay updates. Here's a quick overview:


[h1]Cat vs. Dog Battle Pass[/h1]  

The age-old rivalry between cats and dogs continues! Now, this fateful battle has erupted in Party Animals! Are you Team Cat or Team Dog? It's time to make your choice, join this epic showdown, and defend your faction!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/df7c8089aa6f1c1bd5f94abcac466497641f29c6.png[/img]  
During the event, players must choose between [b]Team Meow[/b] and [b]Team Woof[/b].

[b]Once the choice is made, it cannot be changed.[/b]

XP gained while leveling up your chosen faction pass adds to your faction pool. In the end, faction with higher total XP will be declared winner. 

Reaching tier 30 wiil give you 60% off for the ultimate mystery outfit. If your faction wins on top of this, the ultimate mystery outfit becomes free. You can spy in the other faction to unlock their pass rewards after tier 30.

The winning faction will be able to purchase both their and the other faction's ultimate mystery outfits. The losing faction will only be able to purchase their own faction's ultimate mystery outfit.


[h1]New Maps[/h1]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/ee95f7153013bfe297e80402584e468080db38bf.png[/img]
[b]【Nemo Kart - Shanghai by Night】[/b]  The streets of Shanghai come alive under the cover of night, transforming into a high-octane racetrack! Neon lights flash as cars zoom by, and familiar scenes now present brand-new challenges. Are you ready to face these mysterious opponents?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/054883215824d403a1d001fe833090906e3c0371.png[/img]
[b]【Nemo Kart - Snowville】[/b]  This seaside village, blanketed in snow year-round, has become a winter wonderland for racing! The roar of snowmobiles echoes through the air—who will dominate the track in this extreme environment?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/e764334c883664190b7fa41fe413e33be4135a64.png[/img]
[b]【Last Stand - Ring of Garfat】[/b]  In response to overwhelming player demand, the arena from the Deserted Island Boss Fight is now available as a Survival mode map! Who will emerge victorious in this chaotic brawl and claim the title of the ultimate survivor?


[h1]Winter Cabin Update[/h1]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/b9cea597a0d4cf47cbb7bd06ede228d8f103de35.png[/img]
To celebrate the game's one-year anniversary, Nemo has decked out the Winter Cabin with festive birthday decorations! New additions include a vending machine and a dressing mirror. The vending machines even stock several brand-new varieties of items—go check them out!


[h1]Board Game - Fishy Business[/h1]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/9b3e85bbf99eeb77d714499f9e84e7642feee8cc.png[/img]
Players will be divided into two teams: the Woofs and the Meows. The Woofs must work together to find and dig up the treasure of fishy treats, while the Meows will stealthily attempt to sabotage their efforts. Who will win this epic battle and claim the treasure?


[h1]Feature Updates[/h1]  
[olist]  
[*] Quick Match now supports matchmaking for multiple modes simultaneously  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/d4d7d4a712c9bc589024805be2facd3ae0e58610.png[/img]
[*] Challenge levels now feature a save-and-exit option, allowing players to save their progress  
[/olist]

[h1]Experience Improvements[/h1]  
[olist]  
[*] Adjusted the flow for the challenge levels "Black Sails" and "Deserted Island"

[*] Fixed abnormal wind sounds in the Winter Cabin

Ladies and gentlemen, cats and dogs, please allow me to introduce you to: **[b]Nemo Kart (Beta)[/b]**

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/17bfda319269cc17b53e82f19cd6490d15a39da3.png[/img]

Nemo Kart is a brand new attempt by our development team, where players can choose their own animal and uniquely styled vehicles to compete on the track. Currently, the kart mode features a meticulously designed track. This track incorporates various challenges aimed at testing players' driving skills and strategic use.

Players can choose from different styles of karts, each with unique performance and design. Some karts have better cornering abilities, some earn higher acceleration bonuses from gear boosts, and others have stronger off-road capabilities...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/c3a25fecb279ba495ca32d2f83e5ed3819662360.png[/img]

By participating in Nemo Kart mode races, players can earn a game currency called "gears". These gears can be used to unlock new karts and special paint jobs. Each kart has several different paint options that not only change the vehicle's appearance but also reflect different racing personalities, such as being more aggressive or conservative.

Players can join Nemo Kart mode through quick match or custom games, currently accommodating up to 8 players or AI.

Party Animals
April 16th 2024

[h2][b]What's Next[/b][/h2]

We are actively preparing for our next content update, which is currently scheduled to be released at the end of January. The update includes a new Team Score map; a series of new characters and character skins; a complete redesign of the Winter Cabin map; and a beta test of the Friend Pass feature.

[h3][b]Winter Cabin Gameplay Reconstruction[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/1715367432da246bccea30e61d9348a927bb3efc.png[/img]

We've noticed that many players are looking for a place to chat with others, rather than just fight.

The new Winter Cabin map will provide a leisure space with less of an immediate goal, removing the win-by-points mechanism of the original mode, and adding a new tabletop game. The current plan is to increase the game duration of the Winter Cabin map to 30 minutes.

We hope the new Winter Cabin map will satisfy players who are interested in socializing and chatting. If you guys enjoy this space, we will consider adding more similar leisure modes in the future.

[h3][b]A Series of New Characters and Outfits[/b][/h3]

Party Animals will welcome new characters and a series of outfits, replacing some of the old ones. So, if you have any outfits you're fond of, now's the time to grab them!

[h3][b]Friend Pass Beta Test[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/594876fc9d1e1abfc619eac509cb6c2886c33985.png[/img]

With the help of Steam, we've implemented a new feature: Friend Pass.

In essence, players who have purchased the game can invite one friend who hasn't purchased the game to join in the fun. 

Currently, the Friend Pass version will only be available on the Steam platform, but full-version players on both Xbox and Steam can invite friends with the Friend Pass version to join their team or lobby.

The development team will test this feature in the update at the end of January. If everything goes well, we hope to keep this feature. After all, Party Animals is more fun with friends!
